reviews.text: Great wee shop. Brill range of products for a variety of animals.

Abysmal, dishonest and deceitful. The resident "dog groomer" Emma took a deposit up-front which was understandable but with very late notice she unexpectedly asked if the appointment could be moved forward later in the afternoon. After agreeing and arriving at the specified changed appointment time, she contacted me 10mins afterwards to advise she wouldn't be grooming my dog as it  "went for her". This groomer has no social skills whatsoever.  No previous groomer has ever had any issues. I wouldnt trust her alone with my dog after this experience as my dog seemed very nervous on my return to collect her. To compound this disappointing experience, she refused to acknowledge requests for the deposit to be reimbursed as she didnt even attempt to groom my dog. I will never use this outfit again. Avoid at all cost.
